title: You Think Brain Cells Only Wire Together, Yet Firing Late Actually Weakens the Link
description:
You think Donald Hebb coined fire together wire together! Yet nobody had seen a cell gap in nineteen forty-nine! This is the true story of Donald Hebb's learning rule. Here is what went wrong with old memory theories.
